desc: Bring the graphical desktop up on the persistent SD root (204) at maxcpus=1, which is the only clean core count. The root already has xorg-server, xf86-input-libinput, i3wm, i3status, st, dmenu, fonts, /etc/i3/config, /etc/i3status.conf and /root/.xinitrc (setxkbmap no; exec i3). Verify: X starts on the panel via startx, i3 bar shows WiFi/battery/AC/disk/clock, Super+Return opens st, Super+d opens dmenu, Norwegian keymap is active, and the keyboard backlight responds to brightnessctl. This is the last step to a genuinely usable machine at 1 core and does not depend on 205 at all.
author: claude
